what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from China in Brazil: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 732 Chinese asylum seekers in Brazil, 0.7% of all asylum seekers from China.
Refugees from China, a separate group, live mostly in India, the United States, France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records an armed conflict over East Turkestan territory in China with ETIM in 2008, and an interstate armed conflict between China and India in 2020.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 5324, at the end of 2021; the main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2022.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Brazil.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Brazil only.
